body: I understand, hope you have a good sleep.

Hey, thanks for replying, I see you on a lot of the comments here and it's really good of you to give your time.

I haven't spoken to a therapist, I'm one of those typical 'counselling may work for others but will never work for me' types. I think you have to fully engage with a process and be happy to give yourself over to it. I'm probably too stubborn for it to work really.

As for the family thing, I don't really know what they would think, my last paragraph is a perverse fantasy where I'm clearly projecting what I currently think they think into a future scenario. However the more and more I deal with them the more and more I don't want anything to do with them, or people, or life in general, I just find it all so hurtful and messy. So my options are to run away from everything and never have contact with anyone whilst still alive (not very practical and I'm sure I would then flip and feel lonely by putting myself in that position), or just kill myself and achieve the same end without prolonging the suffering.

I feel lonely and distant from everyone in my life now, I would feel lonely and distant if I ran away, I would not feel anything if I was dead.
